title: Reed field
description: Fine gold stems bend in layered wind and part around a passing pointer.
useCase: Add a small interactive natural surface to a botanical, landscape or material story.
interaction: Brush across the reeds or change the wind strength
reducedMotion: A single posed field replaces continuous wind and pointer motion. Wind controls select static poses.
limitations: Canvas2D, capped at 480 stems and 2× display pixel ratio. Decorative illustration, not a physical vegetation simulation. Pause and document hiding stop the frame loop.
look: Dark slate-teal backdrop with dense, layered gold and olive reed blades topped by feathery seed heads, a large serif wind readout and minimal text controls.
motion: Reeds sway continuously, each springing toward a two-sine breeze angle scaled by the still, breeze or gust setting; stems within 105 px of the pointer bend away from it.
adapt: Per-stem motion is in `draw`: `breeze` sets each target angle, the `[0.15, 1, 2.8]` wind multipliers scale it, a 105 px pointer push adds parting, and a spring (stiffness 75, damping 10) moves `stem.angle`. Stems are generated in `updateSize`; recolour the `hsl` fills.
